post.description: Confirm Checkpoint 1 answers and examples to freeze the Change Card.
Extract and validate the Checkpoint 2 C4 container topology, tool contracts, and Goa-AI guardrails from a candidate Goa design bound to a confirmed Change Card.
Evaluate a feature request at Checkpoint 1, surfacing concrete examples and any genuine domain ambiguity.
Compare evaluated Goa designs and go.mod directives without emitting a blanket compatibility verdict.
Apply a Fast Draft Mode prompt override on the bound target or reject a compiled-rule prompt hack.

DesignSnapshot.title: DesignSnapshot

files.description: File contents keyed by module-relative path, such as design/design.go or go.mod.

DesignSnapshot.description: Exact files of one Go module containing a Goa/Goa-AI design package at design/. Paths are clean, relative to the module root, and name only .go, go.mod and go.sum files; go.mod, go.sum and at least one design/*.go file are required. The evaluator stages exactly these bytes, resolves dependencies only from go.mod and go.sum, and never reads host paths.
